recentTraces.promptPrefix: Explain why a sharp chisel is safer than a dull one.
recentTraces.rawOutputPrefix: A sharp chisel is safer because it needs less force, follows the cut more predictably, and is less likely to slip. A dull edge makes you push harder, which reduces control.

recentTraces.promptPrefix: Give me three tips for fitting a door hinge cleanly.
recentTraces.rawOutputPrefix: Three hinge-fitting tips: mark the leaf with a sharp knife, pare to the line in thin passes, and test-fit often so the hinge sits flush without deep gaps.

recentTraces.promptPrefix: Explain actor isolation in Swift in simple terms.
recentTraces.rawOutputPrefix: Actor isolation means Swift protects data owned by an actor so only that actor can touch it directly. Other code has to await access, which helps prevent races.
